collaboration_gate_operations_committed_.name: collaboration_gate_operations_committed_shape
collaboration_gate_operations_committed_.value: "collaboration_gate_operations"."state" <> 'committed' OR ("collaboration_gate_operations"."result_gate_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "collaboration_gate_operations"."receipt_json" IS NOT NULL AND "collaboration_gate_operations"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL)

collaboration_gate_operations_completed_.name: collaboration_gate_operations_completed_shape
collaboration_gate_operations_completed_.value: "collaboration_gate_operations"."state" <> 'completed' OR ("collaboration_gate_operations"."failure_json" IS NOT NULL OR ("collaboration_gate_operations"."result_gate_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "collaboration_gate_operations"."receipt_json" IS NOT NULL AND "collaboration_gate_operations"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL))

maintenance_runs_state_shape.name: maintenance_runs_state_shape
maintenance_runs_state_shape.value: ("maintenance_runs"."state" = 'running' AND "maintenance_runs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "maintenance_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("maintenance_runs"."state" <> 'running')

mcp_runtime_test_events_shape.name: mcp_runtime_test_events_shape
mcp_runtime_test_events_shape.value:
"mcp_runtime_test_events"."event_seq" > 0
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_events"."ts" >= 0
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_events"."source" IN ('stream', 'live-child', 'post-run-child')
        AND (
          "mcp_runtime_test_events"."external_event_key" IS NULL
          OR (
            length("mcp_runtime_test_events"."external_event_key") = 64
            AND "mcp_runtime_test_events"."external_event_key" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
          )
        )

mcp_runtime_test_session_leases_all_or_n.name: mcp_runtime_test_session_leases_all_or_none
mcp_runtime_test_session_leases_all_or_n.value:
(
        (
          "mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_turn_id" IS NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_acquired_at" IS NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_nonce_digest" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_turn_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_acquired_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_nonce_digest" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

mcp_runtime_test_session_leases_shape.name: mcp_runtime_test_session_leases_shape
mcp_runtime_test_session_leases_shape.value:
"mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."protocol" IN ('opencode', 'claude-code')
        AND (
          "mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_nonce_digest" IS NULL
          OR (
            length("mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_nonce_digest") = 64
            AND "mcp_runtime_test_session_leases"."lease_nonce_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
          )
        )

mcp_runtime_test_sessions_status_shape.name: mcp_runtime_test_sessions_status_shape
mcp_runtime_test_sessions_status_shape.value:
(
        (
          "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."status" = 'active'
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL
          AND (
            ("mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."in_flight_turn_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."idle_deadline_at" IS NULL)
            OR
            (
              "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."in_flight_turn_id" IS NULL
              AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."idle_deadline_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."native_session_state" = 'ready'
              AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."continuation_blocked_reason" IS NULL
            )
          )
        )
        OR
        (
          "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."status" = 'ending'
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."idle_deadline_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."status" = 'ended'
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."in_flight_turn_id" IS NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."idle_deadline_at" IS NULL
        )
      )

mcp_runtime_test_sessions_hash_shape.name: mcp_runtime_test_sessions_hash_shape
mcp_runtime_test_sessions_hash_shape.value:
length("mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."client_create_digest") = 64
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."client_create_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."mcp_config_hash") = 64
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."mcp_config_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

mcp_runtime_test_sessions_enum_shape.name: mcp_runtime_test_sessions_enum_shape
mcp_runtime_test_sessions_enum_shape.value:
"mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."status" IN ('active', 'ending', 'ended')
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."runtime_protocol" IN ('opencode', 'claude-code')
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."native_session_state" IN ('pending', 'ready', 'unusable')
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."cleanup_state" IN ('not-started', 'pending', 'complete', 'quarantined')
        AND (
          "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL
          OR "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."end_reason" IN (
            'user', 'idle-timeout', 'mcp-deleted', 'mcp-disabled',
            'mcp-config-changed', 'access-revoked', 'runtime-disabled',
            'runtime-deleted', 'runtime-profile-changed',
            'runtime-session-reset', 'capture-truncated',
            'capture-incomplete', 'session-unusable'
          )
        )
        AND (
          "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."continuation_blocked_reason" IS NULL
          OR "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."continuation_blocked_reason" IN (
            'mcp-config-changed', 'runtime-profile-changed',
            'capture-truncated', 'capture-incomplete'
          )
        )
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."turn_seq" >= 0
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_sessions"."session_version" >= 0

mcp_runtime_test_turns_enum_shape.name: mcp_runtime_test_turns_enum_shape
mcp_runtime_test_turns_enum_shape.value:
"mcp_runtime_test_turns"."status" IN (
          'queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed',
          'canceled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted'
        )
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."capture_state" IN ('live', 'complete', 'truncated', 'incomplete')
        AND (
          "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."capture_incomplete_reason" IS NULL
          OR "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."capture_incomplete_reason" IN (
            'stream-persist-failed', 'stream-frame-limit-exceeded',
            'child-capture-failed', 'post-exit-flush-timeout'
          )
        )

mcp_runtime_test_turns_counter_shape.name: mcp_runtime_test_turns_counter_shape
mcp_runtime_test_turns_counter_shape.value:
"mcp_runtime_test_turns"."seq" > 0
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."hard_deadline_at" >= "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."created_at"
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."capture_last_event_seq" >= 0
        AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."capture_event_bytes" >= 0
        AND ("mcp_runtime_test_turns"."capture_first_event_seq" IS NULL OR "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."capture_first_event_seq" > 0)
        AND ("mcp_runtime_test_turns"."duration_ms" IS NULL OR "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."duration_ms" >= 0)

mcp_runtime_test_turns_lifecycle_shape.name: mcp_runtime_test_turns_lifecycle_shape
mcp_runtime_test_turns_lifecycle_shape.value:
(
          "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."status" = 'queued'
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."started_at" IS NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."finished_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."status" = 'running'
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."started_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."finished_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."status" IN (
            'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted'
          )
          AND "mcp_runtime_test_turns"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL
        )

memories_scope_type_shape.name: memories_scope_type_shape
memories_scope_type_shape.value: ("memories"."scope_type" = 'global' AND "memories"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("memories"."scope_type" != 'global' AND "memories"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

memory_scope_move_events_from_scope.name: memory_scope_move_events_from_scope
memory_scope_move_events_from_scope.value: ("memory_scope_move_events"."from_scope_type" = 'global' AND "memory_scope_move_events"."from_scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("memory_scope_move_events"."from_scope_type" IN ('agent','workflow','repo','repo_group') AND "memory_scope_move_events"."from_scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND length("memory_scope_move_events"."from_scope_id") > 0)

memory_scope_move_events_to_scope.name: memory_scope_move_events_to_scope
memory_scope_move_events_to_scope.value: ("memory_scope_move_events"."to_scope_type" = 'global' AND "memory_scope_move_events"."to_scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("memory_scope_move_events"."to_scope_type" IN ('agent','workflow','repo','repo_group') AND "memory_scope_move_events"."to_scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND length("memory_scope_move_events"."to_scope_id") > 0)

repo_group_nodes_attachment_kind_shape.name: repo_group_nodes_attachment_kind_shape
repo_group_nodes_attachment_kind_shape.value: ("repo_group_nodes"."attachment_kind" IS NULL AND "repo_group_nodes"."cached_repo_id" IS NULL AND "repo_group_nodes"."child_group_id" IS NULL AND "repo_group_nodes"."ref" = '' AND "repo_group_nodes"."subdir" = '' AND "repo_group_nodes"."readonly" = 0) OR ("repo_group_nodes"."attachment_kind" = 'repo' AND "repo_group_nodes"."cached_repo_id" IS NOT NULL AND "repo_group_nodes"."child_group_id" IS NULL) OR ("repo_group_nodes"."attachment_kind" = 'group' AND "repo_group_nodes"."child_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "repo_group_nodes"."cached_repo_id" IS NULL AND "repo_group_nodes"."ref" = '' AND "repo_group_nodes"."subdir" = '')

runtime_session_leases_all_or_none.name: runtime_session_leases_all_or_none
runtime_session_leases_all_or_none.value:
(
        (
          "runtime_session_leases"."lease_node_run_id" IS NULL
          AND "runtime_session_leases"."lease_nonce_digest" IS NULL
          AND "runtime_session_leases"."leased_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "runtime_session_leases"."lease_node_run_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "runtime_session_leases"."lease_nonce_digest" IS NOT NULL
          AND "runtime_session_leases"."leased_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

task_execution_lineage_record_shape.name: task_execution_lineage_record_shape
task_execution_lineage_record_shape.value:
(
        ("task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."record_kind" = 'generation-watermark'
          AND "task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."highest_settled_generation" IS NOT NULL
          AND "task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."highest_settled_generation" >= 0
          AND "task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."operation_generation" IS NULL
          AND "task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."decision_state" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."record_kind" = 'replay-decision'
          AND "task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."operation_generation" IS NOT NULL
          AND "task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."operation_generation" >= 0
          AND "task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."highest_settled_generation" IS NULL
          AND "task_execution_lineage_operation_records"."decision_state" IS NOT NULL)
      )

tasks_workspace_pruning_at_shape.name: tasks_workspace_pruning_at_shape
tasks_workspace_pruning_at_shape.value: "tasks"."workspace_prune_cause" IS NULL OR ( "tasks"."workspace_prune_cause" = 'webhook-terminal' AND "tasks"."workspace_pruning_at" IS NOT NULL )

idx_webhook_deliveries_dedupe.name: idx_webhook_deliveries_dedupe
idx_webhook_deliveries_dedupe.where: "webhook_deliveries"."event_uuid" IS NOT NULL AND "webhook_deliveries"."status" NOT IN ('rejected','failed')

idx_webhook_deliveries_mr_fact.name: idx_webhook_deliveries_mr_fact
idx_webhook_deliveries_mr_fact.where: "webhook_deliveries"."mr_fact_key" IS NOT NULL AND "webhook_deliveries"."replayed_from_delivery_id" IS NULL AND "webhook_deliveries"."status" NOT IN ('rejected','failed')
